ardy.coordinateSystem: right-handed, y-up, z-forward (character faces +Z, right hand at -X)

headlessInvocation.note: Without these env vars the portable build resolves user resources to %APPDATA%\Blender Foundation\Blender\4.2 (observed 2026-08-26). Setting them keeps config/scripts/extensions fully inside the portable dir.
headlessInvocation.extensionRepoLayout: extensions/user_default/ (underscore) — NOT extensions/user/default/. Blender 4.2 creates the User Default repo at extensions/user_default; the slash form is never scanned.

gltfExporter.note: Ships inside the Blender 4.2.23 zip at 4.2/scripts/addons_core/io_scene_gltf2/; no independent version

rigBridge.name: Rig Bridge
rigBridge.bakeBehavior: creates new Action 'Retarget_<source_action>_to_<target.name>' on the target armature; writes hrs_retarget_result/hrs_source_armature/hrs_target_armature/hrs_source_action custom props; never renames or rebuilds target bones
rigBridge.headlessEvidence: background --factory-startup + env vars above: hrs.auto_guess/hrs.execute_retarget/hrs.init_slots/hrs.assign_selected_bone/hrs.pick_armature registered; all 8 gate scene props present (hrs_source_armature..hrs_target_profile). Add-on module resolves to bl_ext.user_default.humanoid_remap_studio.

converter.name: ardy_to_bvh (strict ARDY CoreSkeleton27 -> BVH format bridge)
converter.note: Pure-format bridge, no target-model knowledge (spec §3.2). Deterministic BVH bytes for identical input+profile+version; locked in the committed golden fixture. Requires numpy (input arrays) + scipy (Rotation.as_euler 'ZYX' decomposition, the round-trip contract with ARDY load_bvh_animation). No pytest/jsonschema in this venv, so the Phase 1 suite runs under stdlib unittest.
